process_cause: Meeting closed by cycle cap after 4 cycles without consensus on v2 by Sam (1 ready Mara to 3 not-ready Theo/Priya/Sam); blocking objections O1 mass integration, O2 dump kinematics/tip, O4 battery mass-energy left unresolved and vote taken before deciding recomputes (battery energy-mass, linkage force, stowed envelope) were computed.
